answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 145470 Country: India Title: Basically I am from Allahabad, but sometimes for some work I go to New Delhi for 3 to 4 days, there I offer qasr. So is it ok as per sunnah to offer qasr salah. Please reply me in light of sunnah. Question: Basically I am from Allahabad, but sometimes for some work I go to New Delhi for 3 to 4 days, there I offer qasr. So is it ok as per sunnah to offer qasr salah. Please reply me in light of sunnah. Answer ID: 145470 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 156/159/M=2/1438) Yes, qasr is wajib on musafir . You offer qasr salah when you are a musafir, it is ok. However, it should be known that qasr shall be done only in the fardh salahs with four rakahs and it is when you offer alone or behind a musafir imam. There is no qasr in Maghrib and Fajr salah. Also in case of offering the salah behind muqim Imam there is no qasr , likewise in sunnat and nafl salah. In case there is the situation of fear and worry, for example, you are offering salah on railway station and the train is about to arrive or it is about to leave or you are offering salah inside the train in the passage then in such a case it is better to leave the sunnat and nafl. But if you are in the state of peace and feel comfortable then it is better to offer sunnat etc. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
